text: The customer wants all 12 Lumo Hubs from order LM-52210 delivered by November 21 for an office installation, as only 3 have arrived so far. The previous agent confirmed that the remaining 9 are split into two shipments scheduled to arrive on November 20 (5 units) and November 23 (4 units), and offered to ask the courier to expedite the final shipment without guaranteeing success. Next, the courier needs to be contacted to request expedited delivery for the last 4 units, and the customer must be updated on the status by noon tomorrow.
